notes: Every model file GUO's ComfyUI workflows reference (tools/comfy/workflows/*.json, run.py/img2img.py defaults). setup_studio.py in this folder installs from this file: --check reports presence, default mode clones/downloads what is missing and validates node types against the server's /object_info. URLs were verified Oct 2026: VAST-AI/TripoSplat file list via the HuggingFace API, DreamShaper 4384@128713 via two independent registries (CivitAI API itself timed out - see notes on that entry), BiRefNet/bg-removal + SplatToFile3D + TextGenerate confirmed ComfyUI CORE (docs.comfy.org built-in-nodes), Qwen3-TTS/ASR packs confirmed via their READMEs and node maps. No entry needs manual confirmation.

comfy_dir.notes: The ComfyUI root: the folder holding models/ and custom_nodes/. UO_COMFY_DIR wins when set; otherwise the first guess that exists and looks like a ComfyUI install.

custom_nodes.notes: MIT. After cloning, install its deps manually with the ComfyUI python: pip install -r custom_nodes/comfy_mtb/requirements.txt

After cloning, install its deps manually (portable: python_embeded/python.exe -m pip install -r custom_nodes/ComfyUI-Qwen3-TTS/requirements.txt). Upstream qwen-tts pins transformers==4.57.3, which may downgrade yours. Model weights auto-download on first run (see models below); nothing to fetch by hand.

Separate pack from the TTS one (the clone workflow's ASR nodes carry aux_id DarioFT/ComfyUI-Qwen3-ASR). Deps: pip install -r custom_nodes/ComfyUI-Qwen3-ASR/requirements.txt. Weights auto-download on first run.

core_nodes.notes: No custom pack needed for any of these: they are ComfyUI core in current builds (if /object_info lacks them, update ComfyUI instead of installing a pack). ComfyUI-3D-Pack by MrForExample was checked and is NOT required.

models.notes: CivitAI model 4384 (Lykon DreamShaper), version 128713 = release '8', SD 1.5. Either filename is accepted: the GUO tools default to DreamShaper_8_pruned.safetensors, guo_seamless.json says dreamshaper_8.safetensors (CivitAI's primary filename). CivitAI's own API timed out during verification; version id cross-checked via two independent registries. A registry reports the primary file SHA256 as 879DB523C30D3B9017143D56705015E15A2CB5628762C11D086FED9538ABD7FD (advisory, not fetched from CivitAI directly).
